_readme: Copy this file to ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (Mac) or %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (Windows). Replace /absolute/path/to with the actual path to this repo on your machine. You do not need to enable all servers — include only the ones you want to use.

filesystem._readme: Lets Claude read/write files in ~/Documents/claude-workspace. No extra setup needed.

data-analysis._readme: Lets Claude analyze CSV/JSON files in datasets/. Run 'uv run examples/data-analysis/generate_sales_data.py' first to generate sample data.

database._readme: Lets Claude query SQLite (default) or PostgreSQL. Run 'uv run examples/database/load_sample_data.py' first to create the sample SQLite database.

web-api._readme: Lets Claude call the e-commerce/analytics REST API. Start the mock API first in a separate terminal: 'uv run examples/web-api/mock_api.py'

task-manager._readme: Lets Claude manage a persistent task list. No extra setup needed.
